I am getting older now, 57 years, and I have farmed this land for many seasons. Maize needs good feeding, so I will put some DAP and urea like the cooperative sells, though not the full package the extension people tell us — money is tight. I keep cattle, so I carry manure to the plot too, and I will buy a little improved seed from the cooperative because maize pays back when the rains are good. I do not irrigate; we wait for the meher rains. My sons and I will do most of the work ourselves, but for weeding I will call a few neighbors and pay them.
